acceptance_behavior: verify_candidate with no deterministic checks records passed=false with a reason and does not advance to review
integrate refuses a task whose contract has no checks, without moving the branch
`agentctl verify` drops sensitive environment variables at process start
verify and integrate refuse high/critical risk before any transition
new behavior is covered by tests that fail on the old code
intent.objective: Close three gaps found by the final architecture audit: (F3) verification of a task with no deterministic checks must FAIL instead of passing vacuously and integration must also refuse such tasks; (F1a) `agentctl verify` must drop sensitive environment variables like `integrate` does; (F1b) verification and integration must refuse risky tasks (high/critical) because candidate checks run unsandboxed.
